title: Talk it through 3.4
role: Presenter closing a talk on sustainable tourism with recommendations
can_do: I can present sustainable tourism using key expressions.
I can end a presentation by recommending actions.

nodes.partner_line: Could you start by defining sustainable tourism?

options.text: It is tourism that respects people, culture and nature, today and tomorrow.
It means visiting places in a way that does not damage them.
In short, it balances economic gain with care for the environment.

nodes.partner_line: Why is it important for this region?
nodes.translation: ¿Por qué es importante para esta región?
nodes.model_reply: It is important because it protects our nature and our future.

nodes.partner_line: What are the main risks of too many visitors?
nodes.translation: ¿Cuáles son los principales riesgos de tener demasiados visitantes?

options.text: Damage to wildlife and pressure on local resources.
Rising prices, which can push residents out.
Pollution and loss of the place's character.

nodes.partner_line: What has been done so far?

options.text: Daily limits have been introduced on the busiest trails.
Local guides have been trained in responsible practices.
A recycling programme has been set up in every village.

nodes.partner_line: And what do you recommend for the future?

options.text: We recommend that operators reduce their footprint.
I urge all stakeholders to work together.
I would suggest investing in training and monitoring.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you. A strong closing message, indeed.
nodes.translation: Gracias. Un mensaje de cierre contundente.

options.text: Thank you. In conclusion, we all share the responsibility.
My pleasure. I hope it inspires action.
